parsed.post: Huge win! Increasing depth to 8 while utilizing all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb from 1.0357 to 0.8771. It seems the previous failure was due to either the learning rate or the lack of data shards. I'll now try to refine the learning rate and add a small warmup to stabilize this high-capacity, data-rich setup.
parsed.description: Decrease learning rate and add warmup ratio to stabilize the high-capacity depth-8 model trained on all 11 shards.
